description: Erases ONE end user from an app for good, for a data-deletion request: saved data, messages, record, review and favourite. Their Neblla account and other apps stay, purchases stay as payment records, and their subscriptions here are cancelled at once, unrefunded. Closes their erasure request. To reset only their data: neblla_update_user_data; to block them: neblla_set_ban_status. More: neblla_get_llms tools/erase_user

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

confirm.description: true runs the irreversible erase; without it nothing changes. Only after the developer agreed.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

userId.description: The user's `_id` from neblla_list_users (userObjectId in neblla_list_erasure_requests).

name: neblla_erase_user
title: Erase a user's data
